name: foresight
lore:
# Foresight: The Glimmer of the Eternal Now

To cast *Foresight* is to step outside the linear flow of mortality. As the incantation peaks, the caster feels the Weave not as a chaotic storm, but as a vast, crystalline loom. It feels like cool silk sliding against the soul, sharpening the senses until the air itself tastes of "tomorrow."

Visually, the recipient is wreathed in a faint, prismatic distortion—a shimmering "after-image" that dances at the periphery of vision. To the enlightened eye, ghostly echoes of the immediate future overlap with the present; a blade’s path is revealed heartbeats before the steel is even drawn.

Legend attributes this magic to **Ione the Sightless**. It is said she bartered her physical eyes to the Fates for a single drop of primordial starlight. Upon drinking, she ceased to see the world as it was, perceiving instead the tapestry of what *must* be. During the Fall of Aethelgard, she walked through a tempest of arrows as if they were falling leaves, never once breaking her stride. 

Use this gift with humility, traveler; to see the end of all things is a heavy crown.
